description: Confidence-weighted spaced-repetition boost when the user has used a word correctly: the card moves further out in the review schedule. Logs an answer row even if no flashcard exists.

lang.description: Language tag of the word: base ISO with an optional region (en, en-us, pt-br). Matching is on the base code, so any regional variant matches. Omit it and the user's own primary learning language is used.
